The leaf shows dark/black spots scattered across the surface, with the leaf appearing somewhat dull and discolored. The spots are small, dark, and irregularly distributed.

Key observations:
- Multiple small dark/black spots on the leaf surface
- Leaf has a generally mottled, grayish-green appearance
- No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery Mildew)
- No black sooty encrustation covering the surface (rules out Sooty Mould as primary)
- No gum secretion or twig withering visible (rules out Die Back)
- The dark spots match Anthracnose: irregular brown-to-dark spots on leaf surface

The pattern of scattered dark spots on a mango leaf with irregular distribution is consistent with Anthracnose symptoms.
